concerns.text: FR-001 (and SC-001) require a *pilot human manipulation check* where ≥80 % of coders confirm the moral narrative is preserved. T003 only performs computational checks (CLIP, RMS contrast, texture) and never collects or verifies any human ratings, thus weakening the functional requirement.

T003 introduces a new metric `moral_intent_preservation_score` (≥0.90) and related fields not specified in the spec. This constitutes constitution drift (Principle VI) and replaces the spec‑defined human‑validation step with an unauthorized model‑based check.

The response logging schema in T004 attempts to satisfy both `response.schema.yaml` and `survey_responses.schema.yaml` by including `participant_id`, `user_id`, `variant_id`, `stimulus_id`, and a `salience_level` field. Neither contract permits these extra properties, and `salience_level` is not part of either schema, violating FR-003 and the contract definitions.

FR-006 mandates effect‑size computation using Type III Sums of Squares (or an equivalent method) for the CLMM. T006 only reports odds ratios and confidence intervals without any mention of Type III calculations, thereby weakening the required statistical reporting.

SC-005 requires a pre‑registered precision threshold (currently `[deferred]`). T006 raises `PreRegistrationError` if `config/pre_registration.yaml` is missing or unverified, yet no task creates this configuration file, so the pipeline will fail and the requirement is effectively dropped.
